request.style: English, advent worship with Celtic colours, warm male and female duet, low whistle, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft pads, slow build, 76 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The night is long, the lamps are lit
We wait like watchmen at the gate
The world is weary, hearts are cold
We hold the promise that was told

[Chorus]
Yes, I am coming soon
Amen. Come, Lord Jesus
Yes, I am coming soon
Amen. Come, Lord Jesus

[Verse]
I am the Alpha and the Omega
The First and the Last, the Beginning and the End
I am the Root and the Offspring of David
The bright Morning Star

[Chorus]
Yes, I am coming soon
Amen. Come, Lord Jesus
Yes, I am coming soon
Amen. Come, Lord Jesus

[Bridge]
The Spirit and the bride say, Come
Let the one who is thirsty come
Let the one who desires take the water of life as a gift

[Outro]
The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all
Come, Lord Jesus
